term: issuance at a signal's named station
definition: For every station n and every code j at its output, issued j holds. The issuing station is exactly the code j, not merely some source. This is issuance in the supplied role, not temporal firstness, uniqueness of issuing acts, existence of a substance, necessary existence or adequate explanation.
note: Derived conditionally from the two separate local interfaces by finite propagation of a fixed code. No nonempty signal is assumed. The omission controls use formal assignments on the same Nat carrier, not metaphysical possibilities.
